notes: Five random 0xd5-byte contact records with record 2's active flag clear, one or random and sub-buffers behind records 2 and 3; the accumulator reset flag clear or set; random input doubles. The projection (0x11c484), point/force (0x11c584, logged record and four stack doubles) and rotation (0x11c4ec) helpers write distinct per-call data into their output buffers, and the store step (0x11c350) logs its record and the contents of the point, force and rotation buffers, so buffer routing is checked without comparing stack addresses.
